note: Lions Club community park in Clermont on Indianapolis's west side, close to the speedway and the NHRA track; a train track runs near the park. --Claude
summary: Rate $35 confirmed; added season Apr 1-Nov 14, 30A with shared water (not at site), 40 sites, showers/dump/wifi, online + phone booking. Note cleaned of rate and RV Life line.
flags: PRIVATE GATE FACTS: posted $35/night, $245/week on its own rates page (read 2026-10-31); nearest gateway Indianapolis metro 15 km; Good Sam status not found in operator pages; live website with phone (463) 298-8789; family has not stayed. GOOGLE MAPS 4.7 over 160 reviews; the reviews on the operator's page read well ('restrooms and showers, while dated, were spotlessly clean'; 'kind of close to a train track but it was not a deal breaker').
OPEN TO THE PUBLIC: yes. Run by the Clermont Lions Club, a 501(c)(3), with no membership requirement on any page; reviewers are passing travellers ('perfect stop over for us overnight').

LONG-STAY: the operator also markets monthly sites from $650 'for extended stays, remote work, or seasonal living', but the monthly share is not posted and the park closes Nov 14-Apr 1, so no winter residents; it posts a nightly rate (test 2 passes). Test 4 cannot be counted from the pages.

Unverified: the booking popup's engine (nothing loads without a click flow), any site length (no max stated; reviewers' sites 'roomy', back-in), and sewer at the site (operator lists only electric + shared water + dump; one reviewer: 'water but no sewer').
Pin matches Google Maps' place point (39.81112,-86.31993) at 3201 Tansel Rd; not re-read on imagery.
